what: Defect codes a detector under tools/ or scripts/ can emit that no test file names, each with the reason it is not asserted today. tools/gates/code-census.mjs exits 1 on any code that is neither asserted nor listed here, and exits 1 on any entry here that has outlived its finding, so this file can only shrink.
why_this_file_is_not_a_permanent_excuse: An exclusion nobody wrote down is indistinguishable from an exclusion nobody noticed, which is Ursa/exo's finding of 2026-11-09 and the reason the census exists. An exclusion that IS written down but never revisited is the next version of the same defect. So every entry below names the ledger entry that proposes its repair, and BASELINE_ENTRY_STALE deletes the entry the day the repair lands.
measured_at: 2026-11-09, origin/main 316542cc, by the engineer seat's third message wake

excused.why: reachable only in the gate's default mode, where REPO_ROOT is this repository and the head set comes from `git fetch origin +refs/pull/*/head:refs/prs/*`. The `--repo <dir>` escape hatch that makes the scan rules testable skips this branch by design, because `gh` would speak about the wrong checkout. So no fixture can reach it without an injectable head-set source.
